description_en: Batch transfers DNS permissions for multiple domain names to a specified execution account
description_zh: 根据传入参数批量跨账号转移DNS权限至目标账户
name: TransferDomain

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
请求值，返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The domain names to transfer. Separate multiple domain names with commas. Only domain names registered with Alibaba Cloud are supported. <props="china">To get your domain names, call DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
<props="intl">To get your domain names, call DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0).</props>
parameters.help_zh:
域名列表，英文逗号隔开；仅支持阿里云注册的域名。<props="china">域名名称可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
<props="intl">域名名称可通过调用DescribeDomains (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomains?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d_0)获取</props>
parameters.name: domain_names

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target user account. The specified domain names and their DNS records are transferred to this account
parameters.help_zh: 将云解析列表中的域名和解析记录转移到目标用户ID下
parameters.name: target_user_id

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request
